ctx.x: I was getting strength back and finally one day I walked around the park, after a few days I got so I could walk pretty well. So one day I walked out of the park on the other side and I walked down and here was Rube Wolfe working in a [transho De- Marco] Theater. So I was -- felt kind of whoozy, and I thought, well I'll go in. And I went in and sat down. And guess who knocked me clean out, when I heard him?
